records.title: Stage code and template hashing in run identity
records.rule: Run identity does not establish hashing of all stage code/templates.
records.absence_reason: Stage-level code digest verification is deferred to v2 backlog.
records.negative_contrast: Run ID alone authenticates all algorithm bytes / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Preserve candidate commit and code/template evidence separately; close only with stage-identity binding tests.
records.closure: Implement cryptographically bound stage manifest hashing all pipeline script and prompt template bytes.

records.title: Engine and renderer stack authentication beyond binary SHA
records.rule: Engine/renderer pin authentication beyond binary SHA is deferred.
records.absence_reason: Host graphics driver and rendering backend authentication deferred to v2.
records.negative_contrast: Binary hash represents complete rendering stack attestation / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Record supplied version/renderer/platform and narrow evidence scope; close with authenticated renderer validation.
records.closure: Add GPU driver, Vulkan/GLES library hash, and Xvfb display server state verification.

records.title: Settling frames simulation hold semantics
records.rule: Settling frames are not a true simulation hold.
records.absence_reason: True engine physics pause during settling frames not implemented.
records.negative_contrast: Asserting frozen simulation during settle / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Document advancing tick/render mapping and narrow selectors; close with tested hold semantics.
records.closure: Implement engine time-scale or physics-freeze pause during settling intervals.

records.title: Hook and probe headers vs HyperBook P-gate qualification
records.rule: Hook/probe headers are not proven equivalent to full HyperBook P-gate qualification.
records.absence_reason: Header syntax checks do not run full headless P-gate execution on GDScript hooks.
records.negative_contrast: Header lint alone qualifies execution / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Show exact executed stage/receipt or absent qualification; close with genuine P-gate evidence.
records.closure: Run full scr-godot-hb-p-gate on all adapter hook.book.gd scripts.

records.title: Hook selftest reviewer mutant exercise
records.rule: Hook selftests do not establish reviewer-mutant exercise.
records.absence_reason: Semantic mutation testing of hook scripts deferred.
records.negative_contrast: Inferring HB-qualified hook without reviewer mutant kills / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Mark hook semantic mutation coverage partial; close with executed reviewer set and target oracle kills.
records.closure: Implement mutant generation and automated killing verification for GDScript hooks.

records.title: Transport backend and model subtype independent verification
records.absence_reason: Provider response verification relies on agy wrapper without independent cryptographic attestation.
records.negative_contrast: Claiming model provider identity independently established / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Record observable worker identity/config, actual response evidence and trust boundary.
records.closure: Close with authenticated backend/subtype negative controls and provider receipt signatures.

records.title: Contact-sheet and distinct-event pair media modes
records.rule: Contact-sheet / distinct-event pair media modes are deferred.
records.absence_reason: Schema includes contact_sheet enum but media generation is deferred.
records.negative_contrast: Schema enum alone constitutes supported functionality / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Advertise only supported selectors (frame, pair, clip); reject unsupported recipes.
records.closure: Close with end-to-end mapped-evidence tests for grid contact sheets and distinct-event pairs.

records.title: Alternative evidence preparation on model abstention retry
records.rule: Abstention retry lacks alternative evidence preparation.
records.absence_reason: Model CANNOT_SEE abstention retries with identical media rather than enhanced crops/contrast.
records.negative_contrast: Assuming retry promises clearer evidence / rejected claim.
records.mitigation: Keep explicit CANNOT_SEE/incomplete status; do not fabricate clarity.
records.closure: Close with bounded alternative-evidence policy (e.g. cropped ROI, adjusted exposure) and tests.
